text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan) 2014.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2014

2. Suatu jumlah wang yang tidak melebihi empat ratus lapan puluh juta satu ratus

sembilan belas ribu ringgit (RM480,119,000) hendaklah dikeluarkan daripada

Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran

Rancangan Keselamatan Sosial bagi tahun 2014 sebagaimana yang diperuntukkan

dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Peruntukan

Emolumen RM 175,257,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan RM 169,681,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain RM 1,037,000

 Perbelanjaan lain RM 43,906,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan RM 90,238,000

Jumlah RM 480,119,000

Dibuat 6 Mac 2014

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)58/XIX]

DATO' SRI RICHARD RIOT ANAK JAEM

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 72 of the Employees' Social Security

Act 1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security (Supply)

Regulations 2014.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2014

2. A sum not exceeding four hundred and eighty million and one hundred and

nineteen thousand ringgit (RM480,119,000) shall be issued out of the Social Security

Fund for expenditure on the administration of the Scheme of Social Security for the

year 2014 as provided in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Allocation

Emoluments RM 175,257,000

Supplies and services RM 169,681,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments RM 1,037,000

Other expenditures RM 43,906,000

Landed property, plant and equipment RM 90,238,000

Total RM 480,119,000

Made 6 March 2014

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)58/XIX]

DATO' SRI RICHARD RIOT ANAK JAEM

Minister of Human Resources
